targetTest: 59-17 rail motion commands — add a Motion channel (G1) > adds Scale to a Position-only rail: ONE channel, one identity key at frame 0 with hold easing

actual: addMotionChannel is not exported yet (typeof !== 'function'), so every command row throws a TypeError; resolveMotionCommandAvailability falls through to 'This Motion command is not available.' / 'Select a Motion channel first.' for the new command id, and hasKeylessChannel is not an input member.

Six failures are TypeError 'addMotionChannel is not a function' raised by the target rows themselves; the two availability failures are assertion diffs on the exact 59-17 sentences. No unexpected green and no unrelated failure.
